name: What is the difference between a patio and a terrace?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a patio and a terrace?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a key difference is that a patio is typically built directly on the ground level, often adjacent to a house. A terrace, on the other hand, is usually an elevated outdoor space, often constructed on a raised platform or integrated into a hillside, providing views and sometimes accessible from an upper floor. Terraces commonly feature structural elements and can be more complex in their construction compared to ground-level patios.
acceptedAnswer.description: A patio is typically ground-level, while a terrace is an elevated outdoor space, often with structural support, providing views.
